messages:
Carla: Heads-up: NimbusEdge onboarding account showed a surprise token spike this morning. 24h delta +170%. Adding to QBR prep and renewal risk watch. :warning:
Sam: Is this across the board or a single endpoint?
Isha: Quick triage 1% is embeddings from their realtime ingest worker. Looks like duplicate reprocessing after a failed webhook ack.
Carla: ops-bot posted the alert:
ops-bot: ALERT account=nimbusedge metric=tokens_24h change=+170% link=https://app.redwood/alerts/ne-3321
Sam: Can you run a 30d projection so we can model credit exposure in the QBR? Also want a conservative vs sustained scenario.
Isha: Running quick SQL, returning numbers in a few mins. Query: 
```
SELECT SUM(tokens) as t24 FROM usage WHERE account_id='nimbusedge' AND ts > now()-24h;
```
Carla: While Isha runs that, I'm going to schedule a 20m enablement touchpoint to walk through retry/backoff and batching. Recommend we offer a short checklist and a code snippet for idempotent retries.
Isha: 24h tokens = 2.8M. Projection (sustained) = ~84M / 30d. Conservative (post-moderation) = 18-30M. Sending CSV to ticket CS-4124.
Sam: Thanks. Estimated spend if sustained ~ $2.6k/mo at current tier. I'll add both numbers to the QBR slides and flag for potential one-time credit if they were unaware.
Isha: I applied a soft throttle on /v1/embeddings (2.0M tokens/day) and rolled their non-critical pipelines to a lower-cost quantized model temporarily. ops-bot confirmed.
ops-bot: NOTE guard applied route=/v1/embeddings account=nimbusedge soft_limit=2000000 tokens/day. Ticket=CS-4124
Carla: Perfect. Action items for the QBR: 1) billing scenarios + conservative/sustained numbers (Sam) 2) enablement call + checklist (Isha) 3) temporary guard + model fallback (Isha) 4) decision on credit vs paid enablement (Carla).
Sam: I'll include a short slide on recommended mitigations and the estimated dollar impact of model fallback.
Isha: After the enablement call I'll capture any product asks (client-side batching helper, server idempotency) and surface quick wins vs roadmap items.
Carla: Marking renewal risk as "monitoring; medium" for now. We'll update after enablement. :white_check_mark:
